updateLog.en:
[New] MD3 navigation bar
The original one is named Minimal navigation bar
Can be selected in settings or setup wizard
[New] Backup and restore
Can back up settings preferences, favorites, and other data
[New] When the same music file is duplicated into two copies
If identical, one copy will be filtered out
[Fix] Compatibility issues on lower Android versions
